judgement.reason: The WHO passages support that the African Region had 95% of 2024 cases (265m/282m), but the Target Malaria passage states 11 African countries account for about two-thirds of global cases/deaths, contradicting the statement's denial of that point.

units.text: Span 88 explicitly enumerates 11 African countries (Burkina Faso, Cameroon, DRC, Ghana, Mali, Mozambique, Niger, Nigeria, Sudan, Tanzania, Uganda) and states they account for approximately two thirds of global malaria cases and deaths. units.text: Span 942204df (context) reports that ten African countries account for 66% of all malaria cases worldwide, and Span 6 states the Africa Region accounts for 94% of cases globally, neither of which identifies eleven countries or confirms they account for most worldwide cases in 2024.
